# Total TypeScript

> > Professional TypeScript training by Matt Pocock featuring interactive exercises, workshops, and tutorials for mastering TypeScript, React, and modern JavaScript tooling.

Total TypeScript offers exercise-driven learning paths from beginner to advanced TypeScript concepts, including specialized content for React developers, team training programs, and practical guides on tsconfig, type transformations, and runtime validation with Zod. Created by TypeScript educator Matt Pocock, the platform combines free tutorials with professional workshops covering 200+ hands-on exercises.

## Key Topics

- TypeScript fundamentals and essentials
- React with TypeScript
- Interactive exercises and hands-on learning
- Type transformations and mapped types
- Generics and advanced patterns
- TypeScript errors and debugging
- tsconfig.json configuration
- Zod runtime validation
- Node.js TypeScript support
- JSX type checking
- Type guards and type predicates
- VS Code TypeScript tooling
- Beginner to advanced learning paths

## Getting Started

- [Professional TypeScript Training by Matt Pocock  | Total TypeScript](https://totaltypescript.com): Homepage for exercise-driven TypeScript workshops and training by Matt Pocock
- [How To Learn TypeScript In 2025 | Total TypeScript](https://totaltypescript.com/learn-typescript): Step-by-step guide with focused questions for learning TypeScript in 2025
- [TypeScript Learning Path | Total TypeScript](https://totaltypescript.com/typescript-learning-path): 22-65 hour curriculum covering TypeScript from basics to advanced patterns
- [Beginner's TypeScript Tutorial | Total TypeScript](https://totaltypescript.com/tutorials/beginners-typescript): Free interactive TypeScript tutorial covering variables, functions, and errors
- [Kickstart Your TypeScript Setup | Total TypeScript](https://totaltypescript.com/books/total-typescript-essentials/kickstart-your-typescript-setup): Chapter 1: TypeScript's evolution from JavaScript and setup fundamentals

## Reference & Configuration

- [The TSConfig Cheat Sheet | Total TypeScript](https://totaltypescript.com/tsconfig-cheat-sheet): Essential tsconfig.json options with @total-typescript/tsconfig package
- [TypeScript Concepts by Matt Pocock | Total TypeScript](https://totaltypescript.com/concepts): Reference guide for TypeScript concepts like Prettify, mapped types, and React
- [Explained: Cannot use JSX unless the '--jsx' flag is provided | Total TypeScript](https://totaltypescript.com/cannot-use-jsx-unless-the-jsx-flag-is-provided): Fix JSX error by configuring tsconfig.json jsx option for React projects
- [The `Prettify` Helper | Total TypeScript](https://totaltypescript.com/concepts/the-prettify-helper): Utility type to improve hover overlay readability for object types
